title: Coordinate and pullback presentations of the projective line
statement: For every scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], $\mathbf P(\operatorname{Option}(\operatorname{ULift}(\operatorname{Fin}(1)));S)$ is isomorphic over $S$ to $\mathbf P(\operatorname{ULift}(\operatorname{Fin}(2));S)=\mathbf P^1_S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Given a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with arrows $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, $q\prime:X\prime\to Y\prime$, $q:X\to Y$, $g:Y\prime\to Y$, and an isomorphism $e:X\cong\mathbf P^1_Y$ over $Y$, there is an isomorphism $e\prime:X\prime\cong\mathbf P^1_{Y\prime}$ over $Y\prime$ satisfying $e\prime;g_P=g\prime;e$, where $g_P:\mathbf P^1_{Y\prime}\to\mathbf P^1_Y$ is the canonical projective-space map.

proof.text: Use Equiv.ulift, finSuccEquiv and optionCongr to bijectively rename the two homogeneous sections. The existing coordinate reindexing theorem makes the constructed map invertible, and homOfIsFreeGenerator_over proves its base equation.
Transport the given pullback square along the upper-right presentation, and take its universal-property isomorphism to ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map. isoIsPullback_hom_snd proves the base equation.
